description: Apply a promo / discount code to an existing order. Promo codes can only be applied to orders still in DRAFT or SCHEDULED state — before pickup. Requires order code, email, and the promo code (typically 4–12 alphanumeric, e.g. "WELCOME10" or "REF-AB12"). Returns the new total and the discount applied.

email.description: Email used when scheduling. Not needed when the customer has connected their Fold account.

name: apply_promo_code
title: Apply promo code
